information_flow: The first call alone sees all six common inputs and converts them into a sealed policy-free causal frame. The terminal call consumes only that immediately preceding frame, has no direct visibility into raw common inputs or any inherited executable artifact, exercises exclusive policy authority, and emits one complete policy.
name: Sealed Causal Frame to Terminal Policy Genesis
organization: Two-call sequential lineage with one analysis-only edge and exactly one policy-bearing node at the terminal position.

calls.objective: Resolve the supplied evidence into one sealed non-policy analysis of public obligations, objective tensions, rejected inherited assumptions, and admissible causal consequences; relinquish policy authorship and pass only that analysis.
Consume only form_sealed_causal_frame, exercise indivisible first-and-final policy authorship, and emit one complete policy jointly reflecting the frame's public obligations and behavioral stance.
